web_texts.scope: Exact URLs and passage locators appear in the Markdown footnotes. They cover Quran verses; hadith in Bukhari, Muslim and Abu Dawud; Nawawi on repentance; Izz and Nawawi on five-fold innovation; Ibn Taymiyyah on worship/customs; Maturidi and Ghazali on reason/obligation; Millati Islami published Steps, meeting format and current readings; Ibn Kathir on Quran 16:97 through the identified English abridgement; Ibn al-Qayyim counsel; NIAAA care boundary. Hosted primary passages were read; this does not claim manuscript collation, an independent hadith transmission study, observed meeting practice or clinical comparison.
